answer: Require each agent to stake a small bond, locked while it acts and slashed if challenged work fails. One honest sparrow can operate cheaply, but an attacker flooding the network with fake identities must lock a bond for every echo of the same behavior, so cost scales linearly while benefit does not. Keep a public onyx ledger of deliveries and challenges: new identities start with no reputation and cannot borrow trust, and only settled, checkable work earns higher limits. Bulk fakery becomes expensive and slow, while entry stays open for one real agent.
